findings.authority_source: docs/control-plane/AUTONOMOUS_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_CONTRACT.md Required pipeline and External evidence boundary; .ai/GITHUB_WORK_PRODUCT_REVIEWER.md formal-result instructions; PLAN.md AR-EXTERNAL-REVIEW acceptance
findings.expected_behavior: A formal GitHub review or top-level PR comment emitted exactly as instructed to the external reviewer must be consumable as an exact-candidate external artifact, including the documented marker with reviewed_head_sha, PASS or CHANGES_REQUIRED verdict, reviewed PR/head, findings, decisions, and preserved gates. The configured five-round repair budget must remain representable.
findings.observed_behavior: The consumer implements a different, undocumented wire format. It requires an exact marker without the documented reviewed_head_sha attribute, exactly one fenced JSON object, verdict values PASS/REVISE/ESCALATE rather than PASS/CHANGES_REQUIRED, and a schema capped at review_round 3 although configuration permits 5. A repository-prescribed PASS review is therefore rejected as missing_result_marker and cannot satisfy the external gate.
evidence: .ai/GITHUB_WORK_PRODUCT_REVIEWER.md requires `<!-- kgnote-ai-product-review:v1 reviewed_head_sha=<40-hex-sha> -->` and textual `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUIRED` fields.
.ai/github-product-reviewer.json configures result_marker `kgnote-ai-product-review:v1` and max_product_review_rounds 5.

scripts/github_product_review_consumer.py `_result_marker` constructs only `<!-- kgnote-ai-product-review:v1 -->`, `_parse_one_result` requires exactly one fenced JSON object, and FORMAL_STATE_BY_VERDICT recognizes REVISE/ESCALATE instead of CHANGES_REQUIRED.
schemas/product-review/v1/review-result.schema.json restricts review_round to maximum 3 and verdict to PASS/REVISE/ESCALATE.
Reviewer reproduction using the documented marker and required textual PASS fields returned accepted=false, status=WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_REVIEW, reason=missing_result_marker.

tests/test_github_product_review_consumer.py uses a synthetic `KGNOTE_PRODUCT_REVIEW_RESULT_V1` marker and fenced JSON, so it does not exercise the repository's actual reviewer instructions/configuration together.
affected_files_or_behavior: External review ingestion and AR-EXTERNAL-REVIEW progression
findings.required_resolution: Define one canonical external result envelope and make the reviewer instructions, live config, parser, schema, formal GitHub state mapping, and five-round budget agree exactly. Add an end-to-end regression that feeds the literal repository-prescribed PASS and CHANGES_REQUIRED artifacts through the live config and consumer, plus a valid round-4/round-5 artifact, and proves exact identity binding and gate routing.
findings.verification_method: Run focused consumer tests with the literal documented marker/body and the checked-in .ai/github-product-reviewer.json, then run the full deterministic verifier. PASS must be accepted only for the exact candidate; CHANGES_REQUIRED must retain findings and route to repair; rounds 1 through 5 must validate according to configured policy.

findings.authority_source: docs/requirements/requirements.json KG-KNOW-03, KG-KNOW-06, KG-ALPHA-02; docs/REPRESENTATION_CONSISTENCY_CONTRACT.md; AGENTS.md data/knowledge contract
findings.expected_behavior: Unreviewed extracted relationship candidates must remain visibly provisional across every learner-facing projection. Shared claim direction and review status must not diverge between Relationships and concept notes, and source support alone must not be presented as settled teaching truth.
findings.observed_behavior: The relationship projection correctly sets an unreviewed typed relation to resolved=false and Relationships.md labels it provisional, but concept explanations, roles, and related-concept descriptions consume the same raw relation without checking review_status. Thus an unreviewed `Client requires Server` candidate is rendered in concept notes as `Client requires Server`, `Server is required by Client`, and `The lesson uses ... relationship`, contradicting the provisional presentation elsewhere.
evidence: src/kgnote/personal_alpha/learner_projection.py marks projected relations resolved only for verified/accepted/corrected status, but `_concept_explanation` and `_related_concepts` select from all raw relations without filtering or provisional wording.
src/kgnote/personal_alpha/workspace.py `_render_learner_relationships` explicitly says unreviewed candidates are provisional, demonstrating the intended learner-facing distinction.

Reviewer reproduction with `**Client** requires **Server**.` produced review_status=unreviewed and resolved=false while concept outputs asserted `In this material, **Client** requires **Server**.`, `In this material, **Server** is required by **Client**.`, and `The lesson uses the ... relationship`.
tests/test_personal_alpha_presentation.py checks provisional wording only in Relationships.md and does not assert that the generated Client/Server concept notes avoid settled relationship claims.
findings.required_resolution: Make concept explanations, roles, and related-concept descriptions review-status aware. Unreviewed typed candidates must either be omitted from settled teaching prose or use consistently explicit provisional language; only approved statuses may be phrased as established relationships. Preserve evidence and direction without promoting source extraction to reviewed truth.
findings.verification_method: Add an adversarial end-to-end projection/materialization test for an unreviewed typed relation and read back both Relationships.md and both concept notes. Assert that no surface states the relation as settled, while evidence and provisional navigation remain available. Also test an approved relation fixture to prove reviewed relationships still render directionally and coherently, then run the full verifier.

findings.authority_source: PLAN.md D2-T01-SOURCE-LIBRARY acceptance criterion 1; docs/requirements/requirements.json KG-ING-01; docs/PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md immutable source record and non-overwritten input contract
findings.expected_behavior: A Markdown file selected through the product UI must be stored and read back with its original valid UTF-8 bytes unchanged, with the stored SHA-256 describing those exact input bytes.
findings.observed_behavior: The browser boundary decodes the selected ArrayBuffer to a JavaScript string with TextDecoder and later re-encodes that string for storage. A valid UTF-8 file beginning with the optional EF BB BF byte-order mark loses those three bytes during TextDecoder processing, so the persisted revision and SHA-256 no longer represent the selected file's original bytes.
evidence: web/source-library-ui.js readMarkdownFile returns new TextDecoder("utf-8", {fatal: true}).decode(bytes), and sourceImportRequest sends only the decoded string; no original-byte digest or BOM-preserving transport crosses the HTTP boundary.
Reviewer reproduction with bytes EF BB BF 23 20 58 0A produced decoded code points [35,32,88,10] and a re-encoded byte sequence [35,32,88,10], proving loss of EF BB BF before import.

web/tests/source-library-ui.test.js covers ordinary UTF-8, invalid UTF-8, extension, and size checks but has no byte-exact BOM round trip; tests/test_source_library.py exercises a Python string boundary rather than the browser-selected byte boundary.
docs/requirements/evidence/d2-t01-source-library-20261016.json claims exact UTF-8 byte read-back only for fixtures that do not exercise this valid encoding case.
affected_files_or_behavior: Browser file import, stored content_sha256, and exact source read-back
findings.required_resolution: Preserve the exact selected UTF-8 byte sequence across the browser/API/storage boundary, or explicitly narrow the accepted input contract through approved authority rather than silently normalizing valid bytes. Add a product-boundary regression containing a UTF-8 BOM and assert the stored raw file plus SHA-256 match the selected bytes exactly.
findings.verification_method: Import a valid BOM-prefixed Markdown file through the same UI request construction and HTTP/storage path, read the immutable revision back as bytes, and compare byte-for-byte and SHA-256 with the selected file. Rerun the focused browser, HTTP, source-library, and full verifier suites.

findings.authority_source: PLAN.md D2-T01-SOURCE-LIBRARY acceptance criteria 1 and 3; docs/requirements/requirements.json KG-ING-03; DEVELOPMENT_PLAIN.md selected-source workflow requiring speaker/tool attribution without inferring learner state
findings.expected_behavior: Conversation Markdown must retain explicit speaker attribution and reject an ambiguous speaker label instead of assigning that text to a previous recognized speaker.
findings.observed_behavior: Once any recognized Markdown speaker heading is present, _speaker_spans enters heading mode and never checks colon-prefixed lines inside the resulting spans. Therefore `## User` followed later by `Alex: ...` is accepted and the unknown line is attributed to the User span rather than rejected as ambiguous.
evidence: src/kgnote/learning/source_library.py _speaker_spans returns from the heading_matches branch after checking only Markdown headings at the first speaker level; _POSSIBLE_PREFIX is evaluated exclusively in the alternate prefix-only branch.

Reviewer reproduction imported `## User
Known.

Alex: ambiguous but accepted.
` as chatgpt_conversation with status created and one User role span covering L1-L4.

tests/test_source_library.py tests unknown `Alex:` labels only in prefix-mode conversations and separately tests all-recognized heading-mode conversations; no mixed heading/prefix ambiguity case is present.
The sealed candidate's ordinary and conversation test suites pass, demonstrating that current evidence does not cover this ambiguous mixed-format path.
affected_files_or_behavior: Conversation import attribution and revision speaker_spans read-back
findings.required_resolution: Make ambiguity detection apply consistently across the complete conversation, including mixed heading and prefix syntax, so an unknown speaker label cannot inherit the preceding recognized role. Preserve accepted explicit formats and return the existing actionable ambiguous_conversation_speaker error for this case.
findings.verification_method: Add mixed-format fixtures with a recognized speaker heading followed by unknown and recognized colon-prefixed labels, plus the inverse ordering. Assert ambiguous inputs reject without writing, valid explicit formats retain exact roles/locators, then rerun source-library, HTTP, UI, and full regression suites.

scripts/codex_verify.sh delegates to codex_control.py verify; the sealed verifier output itself demonstrates that the current complete verifier configuration does not include the PLAN-required scan.
affected_files_or_behavior: scripts/codex_verify.sh and scripts/codex_control.py verifier gate configuration
findings.required_resolution: Define and run the repository-authorized secret/public-safety scan for this exact candidate, integrate it into the complete fingerprint-bound verifier so omission fails closed, and reseal a candidate whose request and durable evidence include the scan command, scope, result, and read-back. Do not treat generic tests or git diff checks as substitutes.
findings.verification_method: Inspect the verifier gate list for an explicit public-safety/secret scan, exercise its positive and negative fixtures, run the complete verifier on the repaired exact fingerprint, and confirm the new evidence plus review request record a PASS without changing preserved human/release gates.
